source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("social media" OR WhatsApp OR Facebook OR Twitter) AND (Hindutva OR nationalism OR "digital politics" OR dissent OR "lived democracy")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("social media" OR WhatsApp OR Facebook OR Twitter) AND (Hindutva OR nationalism OR "digital politics" OR dissent OR "lived democracy"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("Facebook" OR "Twitter" OR "WhatsApp" OR "social media") AND ("Hindutva" OR "digital politics" OR "lived democracy" OR "dissent" OR "nationalism"))
